analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 14, 2026, discussing operational and financial results amidst industry challenges such as raw material inflation and geopolitical tensions in West Asia. The company reported quarterly revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, an EBITDA of ₹89 crore, and a profit after tax of ₹47 crore, driven by new NPK product launches and disciplined cost management. Management expressed confidence in achieving robust growth and higher capacity utilization across remaining quarters of FY27 despite external supply-side and monsoon-related hurdles. Krishana Phoschem Limited released its financial and operational results presentation for the first quarter of FY27, reporting strong revenue and profit growth driven by sustained capacity utilization and integrated operations. Management highlighted favorable demand fundamentals supported by improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve around 25% to 35%-35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a top-line increase of around Rs. 500 crore from the expanded capacity, leading to total revenue between Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore. So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Including import and manufacturing, management expects 40% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

demand_outlook.claim: National Kharif sowing declined by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares initially due to below-normal rainfall.
demand_outlook.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in rapid recovery in sowing progress and accelerated fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry with comfortable domestic stock levels and a favourable monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne indicating balanced supply-demand conditions and healthy channel inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure even if demand softens, as imports would absorb the impact first.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure. Even hypothetically, if demand were to soften, it is important to note that nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported. Therefore, any impact would first be absorbed by imports, and domestic manufacturers would remain relatively insulated.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, taking total capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved or disclosed.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a capacity expansion enhancing NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that so far no additional capex or expansion plans beyond the implemented ones have been planned.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly EBITDA margin reached 16.7% supported by new NPK product contributions and cost efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: As per our earlier assessment, we were expecting EBITDA margins to remain under pressure in the coming quarters. However, our performance in this quarter has been better than expected, and we believe EBITDA margins will remain healthy in the coming quarters as well.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25%-30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices rose from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin is approximately 7%-8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA came in at Rs. 90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth for Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, the global market witnessed firming input prices driven by supply-side constraints and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27 due to absorbed input cost increases.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA per ton was in the range of Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved NPK-DAP unit capacity utilization of 43% and SSP unit capacity utilization of 121%.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production for the quarter was 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
The company achieved a fertilizer production of 94,103 MT for the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved total production of 397,263 MT for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, changing the face value from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane uncertainties introduced considerable cost pressure and freight cost increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year during April-May 2026 due to raw material and logistics constraints.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the April-May 2026 period, industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year, while SSP production dropped by around 7% year-on-year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorables.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the quarter, creating cost pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia capacity agreement with SECI will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.
management_commitments.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the benefits of the capacity expansion to meaningfully reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
